description: Example 01 with PC_ISOLATION PROCESS and PC_WORKER_TIMEOUT: 01's results in either isolation mode.

evaluations.note: As example 01 (the same search in worker processes): 9 on the reference machine (2026-10-12). BFGS reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 at eval 7 (1.015561e-01, the best), takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9), and its next step cannot move the point: the line search is not run, and the objective-delta test ends the search ("DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached"). Until 2026-10-12 the line search re-evaluated the bound (10) and BFGS took the gradient again (11-12), 12 in all, or ran to MAXEVAL = 30 depending on the sign of the ~1e-13 relative re-evaluation noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation (16 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre).

tolerance_rationale: Example 01's search in worker processes, with 01's tolerances: best loss, components and RCUT2B at the defaults, the evaluation count exactly (9) and 01's status, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached", for the reason given in 01's tolerance_rationale. Until 2026-10-12 the count at the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0 depended on rounding-level noise, and evals_tol 18 (0..30 around 12) and the status "DLIB:BFGS: MAXEVAL reached" were accepted too.
